lines.text: Did you know? Struct is Latin for build.
Structure: a thing that is put together.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus build?

words.ex: The bridge was constructed in only two years.
Participants were instructed to keep a daily diary.

words.mean: a thing that is put together
words.ex: The essay has a clear structure.
